subject: prd/plan-viewer
statement: When rendering a plan, the viewer shall render one card per task carrying every charter field of the task contract (prd:plan-new §4.5 layer 2) plus its badges: mechanical, size band, foundation, routing proposal, and any recorded size or overlap acceptance.
rationale: the charter is what the reviewer approves; omitted fields hide exactly what needs eyes
fit_criterion: golden fixture: every field value and badge of every task appears in the page; a field added to the fixture and not rendered fails
